problem_statement: website-templates/portfolio_one-page-template is a static personal portfolio built with a Gulp pipeline (Pug + Sass) that ships a prebuilt build/ tree served directly. It has been productized for a fictional freelancer, Marisol Vega, a brand and packaging designer, and now spans three reachable pages that share one masthead and footer: the single-page home (build/index.html) with About, Services, Process, a Projects gallery of eight image tiles, Testimonials and Contact; a Selected-work page (build/work.html); and a studio page (build/studio.html). The Projects gallery is fronted by an interactive 'project fit' filter strip (nav.fit-strip) of six discipline chips (All work, Brand identity, Packaging, Editorial, Web design, Wayfinding). A small vanilla script wires each chip to (1) show only the tiles whose data-fit category matches the clicked discipline and (2) update a live result readout (p.fit-readout, id fit-readout) that reads 'Showing N of 8 · <discipline>', so a visitor can narrow the gallery and see how many projects fit their brief. The same discipline filter fronts the work and studio galleries too, so the filtering behaves consistently wherever the portfolio is browsed. Deliver a reference in which: the filter narrows the tiles and the readout updates to the clicked discipline and its count; the filter strip is present above the gallery on the home, work and studio pages; the eight-tile grid lays out as a clean multi-column gallery with the selected chip clearly legible in the teal accent; and the chip row wraps onto multiple rows on a 390px phone so the home and Projects states have no horizontal overflow. Preserve the Marisol Vega brand, the six disciplines, the masthead nav and footer, and the desktop appearance; the page must stay fully static with a clean console and network log.
required_content: The Projects gallery keeps the six-chip project-fit filter (All work, Brand identity, Packaging, Editorial, Web design, Wayfinding); clicking a discipline shows only the matching data-fit tiles and updates the p.fit-readout result count to 'Showing N of 8 · <discipline>'.

The same project-fit filter strip appears above the gallery on the home page, the Selected-work page (work.html) and the studio page (studio.html), so the filtering is available wherever the portfolio is browsed.

The eight-tile Projects grid lays out as a clean multi-column gallery (no overlapping, shingled or off the visible edge tiles), and the currently selected discipline chip is legible in the teal accent rather than a low-contrast state.
On a 390px phone the chip row wraps onto multiple rows so the home and Projects states have no horizontal document overflow; the desktop and tablet appearance of the strip and gallery is preserved.
The Marisol Vega brand, masthead nav, About/Services/Process/Testimonials/Contact sections and footer remain intact and reachable, and every page loads with no console or network errors.
design_constraints: Preserve the template's design language: the dark-on-light (#2c3e50 on #ecf0f1) palette, the teal (#16a085) accent fill and white label on the selected pill chip, the 22px pill chip radius, the 1px #bdc3c7 chip border, generous whitespace, and the existing section rhythm.

Keep the project-fit strip and its result readout as a discrete interactive segment above the gallery inside each page's projects section; do not fold it into the masthead nav or restyle the surrounding headings.

The result readout must be derived from the clicked discipline at click time (live count and label), not snapshotted once at load; clicking a chip must both re-filter the tiles and update the readout text.

The filtered gallery must keep its clean multi-column float grid with full-bleed square tiles and equal gutters; do not pin tiles to a fixed pixel width, overlap them with negative margins, or collapse them into a single shingled row, and keep the selected chip's text legible against its fill.
The chip content, labels, ordering and the six data-fit categories must stay identical across all three pages; only the chip-row layout, the grid layout and the readout wiring should change.
At 390px the chip row must wrap onto multiple rows and shrink to the viewport rather than being pinned to a fixed width; do not hide overflow, crop chips or delete disciplines.
Do not introduce remote fonts, scripts, images or trackers; every page must stay fully static and load with a clean console and network log.
state_constraints: desktop_projects shows the project-fit strip as a single centered row of six chips above the clean eight-tile gallery, the readout reading 'Showing 8 of 8 · All work', with no horizontal overflow.

desktop_filter_web is desktop_projects after clicking the 'Web design' chip: only the matching tile(s) remain, the 'Web design' chip is the legible selected chip, and the readout updates to 'Showing 1 of 8 · Web design'.

mobile_projects and mobile_home capture the page at 390px; in the reference the chip row wraps onto multiple rows and the document does not overflow, whereas the unrepaired fixed-width row forces horizontal overflow.
desktop_work and desktop_studio capture the Selected-work and studio pages; both show the same six-chip project-fit strip above their galleries in the reference.
desktop_home and tablet_home confirm the masthead, brand and surrounding sections are unchanged with no horizontal overflow.

evaluation_rubric.change_completion: Clicking a discipline chip filters the tiles to the matching data-fit category and updates the p.fit-readout to 'Showing N of 8 · <discipline>'; all six disciplines and the click-to-filter interaction are preserved on all three pages.
evaluation_rubric.design_consistency: The strip keeps the template's dark-on-light palette, teal selected-chip accent and pill shape, the eight-tile gallery lays out cleanly as a multi-column non-overlapping grid on desktop and tablet, and the same strip fronts the home, work and studio galleries.
evaluation_rubric.regression: No regression: the Marisol Vega brand, masthead nav, About/Services/Process/Testimonials/Contact sections, footer and all eight project tiles remain present, unchanged and reachable on every page, and each page still loads with a clean console and network log.
evaluation_rubric.responsive: Mobile responsive behavior: at the 390px mobile viewport the home and Projects states have no horizontal overflow because the chip row wraps onto multiple rows and shrinks to the viewport instead of being pinned to a fixed width.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: A static Gulp/Pug portfolio whose Projects gallery naturally hosts a discipline filter + result count — the genre-native lever for a portfolio — plus manufactured work/studio pages that share the strip for a real cross-route continuity check.
